conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new: there was no October preliminary release this time, unlike the 9 July Q2 pre-release. Three brokers agree on a sourced bar (revenue about EUR385m, EBITDA EUR57.6-59m), and independent volume series (India 3W retail +32% in Q3, Italian scooter registrations up 9-11% every month) support a print at or slightly above it. But brokers already cite India, Akros has margin pressure in its number, and the stock trades above every sourced target after +9.3% in 20 days. So the findings roughly offset (impact_sum +0.05) and p_up sits at 51 on an abs_move of 5.5, set from this name's recent results-day moves of 3-6% and the European 'numbers new' base. Both measurements are near zero for the same reason, so there is no gap to explain.

findings.finding: Piaggio Vehicles' India three-wheeler retail (FADA) was 27,209 units in Q3 2026 (Jul 9,598, Aug 8,426, Sep 9,185) against 20,561 in Q3 2025 (7,271 / 7,109 / 6,181), +32%, with market share rising each month (Sep 6.93% vs 5.70%). This supports the commercial-vehicle line behind the +11% organic revenue bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Volume surprises have moved the stock: the 9 July Q2 volume/revenue pre-release (+14% units) closed +5.85%, and the H1 results day (28 July) +5.54%. Q1 (8 May, EBITDA -7%) closed -3.03%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (September 2026 FADA data); July figures at https://www.cmv360.com/news/fada-three-wheeler-retail-sales-report-july-2026, August at https://www.cmv360.com/news/fada-three-wheeler-retail-sales-report-august-2026
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Brokers explicitly cite 'ottime performance in India' and model +11% organic growth, and the stock is up 9% in 20 days. What is left is only the chance that +32% retail (on top of H1 India CV volumes +40.9%) runs ahead of what the brokers put in. If it were fully priced, the estimates would sit above the H1 growth rate, not at +11%. Retail is not Piaggio wholesale, and India is one segment, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: SIAM all-industry 3W dispatches September 2026 98,162 vs 84,635 (https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/india-s-passenger-vehicle-dispatches-rise-21-8-to-4-54-lakh-units-in-september-2026-siam), the industry series, not Piaggio's own

findings.finding: Italian scooter registrations rose every month of Q3 2026 (July +11.4%, August +9.9%, September +11.2% per ANCMA) while motorcycles fell (July -6.5%, August -3.9%, September +1.6%). That mix favours Piaggio's scooter core (Vespa, Liberty, Beverly) over its motorcycle brands (Aprilia, Moto Guzzi).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bluerating has headlined past Piaggio rallies on registration data ('Piaggio torna a rombare a Piazza Affari dopo i dati sulle immatricolazioni'), but those are undated in this hunt. On results days, EMEA two-wheeler weakness drove the Q1 2026 -3.0%.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (September 2026 ANCMA data); July at https://www.moto.it/news/mercato-moto-e-scooter-luglio-2026-immatricolato-in-crescita-ma-le-moto-rallentano.html, August at https://www.insella.it/news/mercato-moto-agosto-2026-scooter-ancora-moto-giu-77851

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is a public monthly series and brokers say 'tenuta delle quote di mercato nelle piazze occidentali'. Italy is one market inside EMEA, Piaggio's brand share is not visible in it, and Europe's two-wheeler market was already +16.8% in H1. Small, and only as a sign that EMEA volume did not crack in Q3.

findings.finding: Margin risk on component and raw-material costs is already in the bar: Banca Akros sees the Q3 EBITDA margin falling 43bp to 14.9% 'per l'aumento dei costi dei componenti', and the CEO warned in July of inflationary pressure to year-end. With Brent at $89, a margin miss below the EUR57.6-59m range is the main downside path.
